#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
long long n,b[20];
long long dfs(long long x,long long sum)
{
	long long num=x/b[sum];
	x=x%b[sum];
	if(x==0)
		return num*sum;
	else
		return num*sum+min(dfs(x,sum-1),sum+dfs(b[sum]-x,sum-1));
}
int main()
{
	cin >> n;
	for(int i=1;i<=17;i++)
		b[i]=b[i-1]*10ll+1ll;
	long long m=0,x=n;
	while(x!=0)
	{
		x/=10ll;
		m++;
	}
	cout << dfs(n,m+2) << endl;
	return 0;
}
